records.title: Canada's 2035 Nationally Determined Contribution
records.summary: Submitted to UNFCCC 11 February 2025. Commits Canada to 45 to 50 percent below 2005 levels by 2035, roughly 381 to 419 Mt CO2e, as a step toward net zero by 2050. Canada's current NDC and a progression from the 40 to 45 percent 2030 target.
records.ocUse: The newest federal commitment, and the top of the domestic target ladder. Use this rather than the 2030 NDC when the plan's horizon runs past 2030.
records.sourceNotes: Core text runs to roughly 30 pages with annexes covering legislative requirements, engagement submissions and provincial input, reaching about 188 pages in total. Corroborated against the UNFCCC NDC registry entry and the ECCC news release of February 2025.

records.title: Vernon Local Government Climate Action Program survey and attestation
records.summary: Signed and submitted 31 July 2024, reporting on the 2023 calendar year. The reporting year is not printed on a cover page; it appears in the question wording, which asks about emissions measured 'for the 2023 calendar year'. Vernon's own stated targets in this submission are 50 percent by 2030, 75 percent by 2040 and 100 percent by 2050, all steeper than the provincial 40 / 60 / 80 legislated targets.
records.ocUse: Shows the provincial survey-and-attestation format local governments file, a useful comparator to OC's own CCAR template. More usefully, it records a neighbouring municipality voluntarily committing beyond the provincial target, which is a relevant reference point when OC sets its own ambition.
records.sourceNotes: Confirmed as the July 2024 submission covering calendar 2023, so this is the correct source URL. A separate August 2025 submission covering calendar 2024 exists at vernon.ca/sites/default/files/2025-09/ and is a different document. BC publishes only the aggregate LGCAP summary, not individual municipal submissions.
